manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: All-Fates Stalker must be exiled by Faceless Butcher, and Wormfang Drake must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Wormfang Drake for its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it exiles Faceless Butcher until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Wormfang Drake's ETB.
When Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield, All-Fates Stalker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When All-Fates Stalker enters, it exiles Wormfang Drake until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of All-Fates Stalker's ETB.
When Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, Faceless Butcher is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it exiles All-Fates Stalker until Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Faceless Butcher's ETB.
When All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield, Wormfang Drake is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
